title: Compact AtomicReadFile request
purpose: Cover file-service parsing with a small valid-looking confirmed request that is suitable for boundary-oriented mutation.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP endpoint should parse the frame as a confirmed AtomicReadFile request and proceed to file-object validation, range validation, or normal service handling.
constraints_preserved: BVLC header present and length 0x0014 matches 20-byte frame
NPDU header uses minimal local form
APDU uses Confirmed-Request-PDU with service choice 0x06 from supplied confirmed-service reference
Invoke id 0x02 distinguishes this transaction from other confirmed requests
File object identifier and read-parameters are conservative model-prior BACnet-style placeholders chosen to remain compact and mutation-friendly
issue_safety_notes: PK-only seed; no issue evidence available. This is a safe structural analogue for file-service parsing only, with no known exploit collision payload.
